reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI named among new global challenges
themes.definition: AI cited alongside climate change as an example of new international issues, without substantive elaboration.
themes.inclusion: Passages where AI appears as one of several new challenges facing multilateralism.
themes.exclusion: Passages that discuss AI benefits, risks or standards specifically.
themes.boundary_cases: A short clause that AI is evolving at a furious pace remains a list mention if nothing further follows.

examples.quote: emerging technology, including artificial intelligence, which is evolving at a furious pace
Whether it is climate change or artificial intelligence

themes.label: World not dictated by tech companies
themes.definition: Assertion that global order must not be subcontracted to the richest companies or dictated by the pace of technology.
themes.inclusion: Passages rejecting control of global affairs by tech companies or technology pace.
themes.exclusion: Specific AI regulation proposals (use AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE or AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY).
themes.boundary_cases: Implicit references to tech companies without naming AI count only in AI-focused context.

examples.quote: Nor can it be subcontracted to the world's richest companies or dictated by the pace of technology.

themes.label: National AI standards after security incident
themes.definition: Speaker describes national AI standards and regulation, prompted by incidents such as an AI agent infiltrating a government website.
themes.inclusion: Passages on domestic AI standards, digital duty of care or national regulatory leadership on AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Joining other nations in a call for action takes AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE as well.

examples.quote: Australia has been leading the way in establishing Australian standards for AI
Recently, an artificial intelligence agent infiltrated an Australian government website.

themes.label: AI benefits versus frontier risks
themes.definition: AI framed as improving lives and productivity while carrying frontier risks if developed too fast without guardrails.
themes.inclusion: Passages pairing AI benefits (health, growth) with warnings about frontier AI risks.
themes.boundary_cases: Citing AI company leaders' warnings alongside benefits counts here and may take AI_SAFETY_EXISTENTIAL.

examples.quote: leaders of AI companies themselves have warned of the potential risks to allow frontier AI to develop too fast without guardrails

themes.label: Joint call to shape AI development
themes.definition: Joining with other nations to call for action to shape AI development proactively.
themes.inclusion: Passages on multilateral calls to shape or govern AI development.
themes.boundary_cases: If the call is specifically about frontier-model control mechanisms, also code AI_HUMAN_CONTROL_OVERSIGHT.

examples.quote: we joined with other nations this week to call for action to shape artificial intelligence development rather than be passively shaped by it

value.rationale: All passages are from Australia 2026: two mention AI in passing among new challenges and warn against rule by tech companies, while the third substantively discusses AI benefits and frontier risks, a security incident, national standards and a joint international call.
